name: Follow Up Emails
author: smackcoders

sections.description:
WP Follow Up Emails is a powerful and user-friendly email automation plugin that helps businesses foster stronger relationships with their customers through timely and targeted email follow-ups. It ensures you stay connected with your customers and nurture your relationships automatically.

You can convert one-time customers into repeat buyers by automating your email communication based on customer actions such as new purchases, completed purchases, abandoned carts, or form submissions. With customizable templates, precise trigger timing, and seamless integration with WooCommerce and popular form plugins, this plugin is the ultimate tool for boosting sales and increasing customer retention.

Key Features:

Automate Multiple Email Sequences
Create automated follow-ups that are triggered based on key customer actions like completed orders, refunded orders, failed orders, abandoned orders, form submissions, and more. Set up multiple follow-up sequences once, and let WP Follow Up Emails handle the rest.

Customizable Emails with Templates
Choose from pre-built templates or create your own using a user-friendly editor. Personalize the content with dynamic tags, such as customer name, order details, or site name, ensuring your emails resonate with each recipient.

Flexible Timing Triggers
You can set precise delays before sending emails after a specific customer event. Whether you want to send an email within minutes, hours, or days after purchase, this plugin gives you the flexibility to optimize your timing.

Seamless WooCommerce Integration
Integrates with WooCommerce to send automatic order confirmations, shipping updates, and abandoned cart reminders. Improve your customer service with timely, relevant emails that guide buyers through their journey.

Easy Form Builder Integration
WP Follow-Up Emails integrates with popular form plugins, such as Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, and WPForms. To stay connected with users, you can trigger follow-up emails based on form submissions, such as inquiries, sign-ups, or contact forms.

Effortless Template Management
You can manage all your email templates from the WordPress dashboard. With a single click, you can activate or deactivate templates and modify them as needed to fit evolving campaign goals.

Email Testing and Previews
Send test emails before delivery to ensure your emails look professional and are free of errors. Preview how your emails will appear in your customers’ inboxes to avoid any last-minute surprises.

Email Delivery Logs
Track the status of your follow-up emails with clear and concise logs. View delivery status, the triggered template, event, and other key details to monitor your automated emails efficiently.

Stay top of mind with your customers. Whether it’s a special promotion or a reminder about an item left in their cart, timely follow-ups drive repeat business and customer loyalty.

Why WP Follow Up Emails?

  • Boost Sales: Automated emails ensure you never miss an opportunity to follow up with potential customers and increase conversions.
  • Save Time: Set up once, and let the plugin handle the rest. No more manual follow-up emails.
  • Increase Engagement: Tailored and relevant content keeps your customers engaged and reminds them about their purchases or abandoned items.
  • Build Customer Loyalty: Keep your customers coming back with personalized communication that shows you care about their needs and preferences.

With this plugin, you can streamline your communication, automate follow-ups, and improve customer satisfaction without lifting a finger. Perfect for WooCommerce store owners, form-based businesses, and anyone looking to enhance customer engagement.

How It Works

Create Your Email Template
Craft your email templates using the built-in editor, and personalize them with dynamic tags like customer name, product name, and order details.

Set Up Triggers

Choose an event type (like order completion or form submission) that will trigger your follow-up email sequence and set up triggers or email time delays to send the email after a particular action is done by the user/customer.

Go Live

Test your templates with test emails and fine-tune them as needed. Once everything looks good, activate your emails, and let the plugin take care of the rest.

Supported Plugins & Platforms

  • WooCommerce: Perfect for WooCommerce store owners to automate order confirmations, shipping updates, abandoned cart reminders, and more.
  • Gravity Forms: Integrate with Gravity Forms to trigger follow-up emails based on form submissions.
  • Ninja Forms: Seamlessly trigger emails when users submit forms built with Ninja Forms.
  • Formidable Forms: Automate communication based on user-submitted forms created with Formidable Forms.
  • WPForms: Integrates easily with WPForms to send follow-ups based on form submissions.

Helpful Resources

Explore our Follow-Up email documentation and in-depth YouTube tutorial to learn more about the plugin and maximize its potential.

You can find more information about the plugin on our official website page

Troubleshooting

  • Emails Aren’t Sending: Ensure your email trigger settings and time delays are configured correctly. Check your email logs for any issues.
  • Dynamic Tags Not Showing: Make sure you’re using the correct placeholders and that they are placed properly within the email template.
  • Integration Issues: Double-check the plugin settings and ensure compatibility with your WooCommerce version or form plugin.

Get Support

If you encounter any issues or need help with setting up WP Follow Up Emails, feel free to create a forum topic. We’re here to assist you and ensure you get the most out of the plugin.
sections.installation:
Installing it is as simple as adding any other WordPress plugin. There are two general methods:

  • Go to Plugins >> Add New
  • Search for Follow Up Emails
  • Click Install Now >> Activate
sections.faq:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. Can I send emails based on specific product purchases?

Yes! WP Follow Up Emails allows you to set up triggers based on product purchases, making it perfect for targeted follow-ups.

2. Is there a limit to the number of email templates I can create?

No, you can create an unlimited number of email templates for various events.

3. How can I ensure that my emails look professional?

Use the email testing feature to send test emails and check how they will appear to customers before going live.

4. Why is my email not being sent?

If your email is not sending, ensure you’ve installed and configured an SMT plugin in your website and you’ve added a cron job to your WordPress site to trigger the emails after particular time delays.
